summary.intent: Execute Phase 34 (E2E Test Expansion & Staging Baselines) — create account cleanup helpers, media/streaming E2E suites, batch download tests, and capture staging performance baselines including BYO-IPFS load tests with Pinata.
summary.outcome: All 4 plans completed and verified (13/13 must-haves passed). Real 200-client sustained load baselines captured (0.17% error rate, 11,174 ops). BYO capacity ceiling run against Pinata (free tier exhausted mid-run). PR #392 created, reviewed, and Copilot/CodeRabbit comments resolved.

repo: Staging Web3Auth init takes ~22.7s — wallet button timeout in E2E tests must be ≥30s when targeting staging (was 20s, causing false failures)
BASE_URL env var was not being picked up by playwright.config.ts — required explicit `process.env.BASE_URL` in baseURL config and conditional webServer suppression
cleanup-helpers.ts derived API URL from localhost:3000 hardcode — needs to derive from page URL hostname to work against staging
SDK load test harness (tests/load/) uses vitest which does NOT auto-load .env files — must source .env manually before running or use dotenvExpand in setup

Running two load test suites simultaneously against the same staging instance exhausted the throttle bypass budget — root cause of apparent 'bypass not working' was concurrent test collision, not a code bug
Pinata free tier pin limits are easily exhausted by capacity ceiling tests (50→1000 clients × 5 files each)
BYO register-cid and ipns-publish return 400 on staging — pin to Pinata succeeds but CipherBox API rejects CID registration (test account likely not configured for BYO mode)
The browser-based load test (load-test.spec.ts) measured Playwright/Chromium overhead rather than API performance — removed in favor of SDK harness which drives 200 headless clients

code.finding: Added BASE_URL env var support and conditional webServer skip when targeting non-localhost; added 127.0.0.1 to local URL detection alongside localhost
API URL must be derived from page URL (replace app subdomain with api subdomain) not hardcoded to localhost:3000; two page.evaluate calls merged into one to eliminate extra browser round-trip
createTestMediaFile added basename() sanitization on filename parameter to prevent path traversal
Vitest does not auto-load .env — env must be sourced in shell before running test command
BYO env vars should be scoped to byo-* scenarios only via conditional; auth token stays as secret, endpoint/protocol/label exposed as workflow inputs with defaults to allow per-run provider swapping

workflow: When two background load tests run concurrently against the same staging instance, they can exhaust each other's rate limit budget even with bypass headers — always run load tests sequentially against staging
Worktree cherry-pick conflicts on STATE.md are common in parallel agent execution — take the worktree version and restore local changes from stash
The classifyHandoffIfNeeded Claude Code runtime bug fires after all tool calls finish — spot-check SUMMARY.md + git commits to determine actual success rather than trusting the failure signal
Playwright MCP browser tools (browser_navigate, browser_snapshot) are useful for debugging staging UI issues directly without writing test code

friction: Multiple cherry-pick conflicts on STATE.md when merging parallel agent worktrees — required repeated stash/restore cycles
34-03 agent hit a git lock contention issue and failed on first attempt, requiring worktree cleanup and retry
Premature phase completion triggered (ROADMAP/STATE marked complete) before load test baselines were confirmed meaningful — required rollback discussion
SSH to VPS failed (timeout/key issue) making it impossible to verify Docker container env vars directly
BYO capacity ceiling test ran silently with 100% pin failures due to Pinata free tier exhaustion — no early warning or partial failure reporting
Vitest's absence of .env auto-loading was non-obvious — caused repeated 'BYO_IPFS_ENDPOINT not set' skips before root cause identified
1Password commit signing occasionally fails mid-session requiring retry with direct git commit
open_items: BYO register-cid and ipns-publish return 400 on staging — tracked as todo: tests/load/src/workloads/byo-file-workload.ts needs investigation, likely test account not configured with BYO mode
New media/streaming E2E specs (streaming-playback, media-preview) use binary stub fixtures — need live environment run to confirm AES-CTR/GCM code paths are actually exercised
BYO capacity ceiling baselines incomplete — Pinata free tier was exhausted; need paid Pinata plan or fresh account to get meaningful per-tier throughput numbers
SDK sustained load test thresholds are tuned for smaller client counts — 200-client run 'failed' on p95 thresholds even though error rate was only 0.17%; thresholds should be recalibrated
GitHub Actions load-test.yml needs LOAD_TEST_BYO_AUTH_TOKEN secret configured in the staging environment before BYO scenarios can run from CI
